title: Xiaohongshu Marketing Agency | Expert RedNote Marketing | Charlesworth

facts.fact: Charlesworth states it has over 25 years of expertise in driving China growth for brands worldwide, with roots in the UK and China.
facts.quote: With roots in the UK and China, Charlesworth boasts over 25 years of expertise in driving China growth for brands worldwide.

facts.fact: The vendor describes Xiaohongshu, also known as Little Red Book or RedNote, as serving as a search engine, e-commerce platform, and lifestyle-sharing app.
facts.quote: Serving as a search engine, e-commerce platform, and lifestyle-sharing app, Xiaohongshu has evolved into a dynamic ecosystem

facts.fact: The vendor's Essential Little Red Book package includes account setup with basic branding, regular posting of content supplied by the client, community management, and essential-metric reporting.
facts.quote: Kick-start your Little Red Book presence with our Essential package, including:

facts.fact: The vendor's Amplify package adds content strategy and creation, Little Red Book Ads, influencer partnerships, and advanced-metric reporting on top of the Essential package.
facts.quote: Enhance all the benefits of the Essential package, with our amplified features, including:

facts.fact: The vendor's Premium package builds on Amplify with key opinion leader (KOL) marketing, comment section management, influencer campaign management, strategic consultation, and enhanced reporting.
facts.quote: Make a real difference with all the benefits of our Amplify package plus premium features, including:

facts.fact: The vendor states its Beijing-based teams are at the forefront of China digital marketing strategies.
facts.quote: Our Beijing-based teams are at the forefront of China digital marketing strategies, deeply connected to market trends and insights.

facts.fact: The vendor describes its Charlesworth Gateway Analytics Dashboard as award-winning and providing real-time access to marketing KPIs across China networks.
facts.quote: Gain control and transparency with our award-winning Charlesworth Gateway Analytics Dashboard.

facts.fact: The vendor has bases in the UK and China and regional offices in South Korea and Japan.
facts.quote: From our bases in the UK and China and our regional offices in South Korea and Japan, we're committed to understanding your business needs
